name: atlaslibs
title: atlaslibs
blurb: a mad-libs RPG generator that quests through the real region names on atlas.jazco.dev — Politics Isle, the Furry Archipelago, the Japanese Shore — mad-libbed together by which ones are actually mapped as neighbors. @10-5.bsky.social asked for a story generator based on the atlas's geography; this is it, six scenes and a hand-drawn map every roll.
